sloka: सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयो ऽपि समागताः ।इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंश्च सीता सुरसुतोपमा ।उवाच सोकसन्तप्ता हनुमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम् ।। ५.३८.५५।।।।
transliteration: sugrīvo vāpi tejasvī harayo 'pi samāgatāḥ ।ityuktavati tasmiṁśca sītā surasutopamā ।uvāca sokasantaptā hanumantaṁ plavaṅgamam ।। 5.38.55।।।।

translations.english: "Hanuman having spoken this way, Sita, resembling a god's daughter, grieving, thus addressed Hanuman:
